title: Apply with Readiness override
description: Applies one Proposal using its bound Dry Run; --force skips Readiness checks only, and Autonomous mode refuses it and requires a project-declared gate and the newest Trial's green verdict for its required words, current policy and live project state. The optional --message must be one line of at most 128 characters. Text summarizes counts and points to the full effects file; --effects prints it, --json keeps the full effects array, and MCP never applies.
